opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases up to £750,000; most grants below £300,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not funded: individuals without formal employment/contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organisation, projects led by schools or FE colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees or PhD-supporting projects, establishment of academic posts, ongoing/rolling-out costs, dissemination-only projects, local charities/statutory replacement, requests for financial help or educational fees from individuals, projects led by organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases possible with strong UK dissemination/impact plans).
opportunities.summary: Research funding for projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines per year (Spring and Autumn); outline application deadline 5 October 2026. Assessed on relevance, impact, conceptual framework, rigour, experience and value for money.

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications bringing together researchers and racially minoritised communities strongly encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society in the UK. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline per year (Autumn); next deadline 5 October 2026. Supports research on racial inequalities, discrimination and pathways to racial justice, including intersectional approaches.
